title: The Root of Corruption
description: I Watching you. you can't hide.
body:
Warning: The mod is a beta version, with no guide, very few events and entities, made using MCreator, The mod author is Chinese.

They have corrupted the entire world, they watching in the void, they have come.

The mod Introduction:
- This is the first horror mod I made, Try to avoid restoring some effects of the old versions of Minecraft, but the effect is still very poor.
- The mod can control your PC in versions after 1.0.1, The mod can also create Alert windows to interfere with you, Show your IP(Your IP will not be leaked to any website or anybody).
- The mod may kick players, and It have already been fixed in version 1.0.1.
- The mod only Refers to The Broken Script and Mark101 and does not Reference to Inside the System or other horror mods.
- The mod open source.
- The performance optimization of this mod is average.
- The sound produced by the mod is very loud.
- There are some creatures in the mod that cannot be spawned. For details on which creatures cannot be spawned, please refer to the source code.
- Behind you.


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

中文：
首先你需要去基岩层上方打一个叫做Forgotten Player的小boss，十分建议你有了全套下界合金套再来打它，或者多建造铁傀儡，打死它后就可以去一个坐标打最终boss了。然后你就可以去末地等待一个黑色方块，实在没时间就用指令获取方块，右击召唤一个叫Lost memory的小boss，然后这个boss需要用铁傀儡击败它。所有小boss被打死后就可以去造Missing装备了，可以用JEI或者一个给配方的事件知道配方，如果小boss打死没掉落物或者被炸掉了就创哥理赔。然后这个最终boss是一个叫undefined的家伙，这个boss非常厉害，可以打死好几个监守者，铁傀儡会被瞬间击杀，船会被炸，还会召唤唤魔者和末影人和烈焰人，打完后吃掉祂掉落的物品后就通关模组了。

English:
First, you need to fight a small boss called Forgotten Player above the bedrock layer. It is highly recommended that you have a full set of Netherite armor before fighting it, or build multiple Iron Golems. After killing it, you can go to a coordinate to fight the final boss. Then you can go to the End to wait for a black block. If you don't have time, use a command to get the block. Right-click to summon a small boss called Lost Memory, and this boss needs to be defeated using Iron Golems. After all the small bosses are killed, you can craft the Missing equipment. You can use JEI or a recipe-giving event to learn the recipes. If a small boss drops nothing or is blown up, obtain the drops in creative mode. Then the final boss is a guy called Undefined. This boss is very powerful, able to kill multiple Wardens, instantly kill Iron Golems, destroy boats, and summon Evokers, Endermen, and Blazes. After defeating it, eat the items it drops to complete the mod.

</details>
